plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Sensatronics EM1 / E4 environment monitors (SENSATRONICS-EM1, enterprise PEN 16174). It reports uptime, temperature and relative humidity of up to four sensor groups, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Reading of the temperature probe in each Sensatronics sensor group (1-4) in degrees Celsius, from groupNTempDataInt (SENSATRONICS-EM1, 1.3.6.1.4.1.16174.1.1.3.3.N.4.0, whole degrees). Readings are converted from Fahrenheit, Kelvin or Rankine according to unitMode (1.3.6.1.4.1.16174.1.1.3.2.3.1.0); out-of-range values, and a reading of 0 from a group whose probe name is empty, are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Reading of the humidity probe in each sensor group in percent, from groupNHumidDataInt (1.3.6.1.4.1.16174.1.1.3.3.N.7.0). 0 is treated as no probe connected and dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
